hints: Each query asks for the maximum of several lines at one x.
Two lines change their relative order at most once.
A Li Chao tree stores the line best at the midpoint and sends the other to the only side where it might win.
analogy: At each interval, keep the midpoint champion and let the challenger compete only where it can still overtake.
example: After adding y=x+2 and y=4, queries at x=1 and x=3 return 4 and 5.
algorithm: Maintain a Li Chao segment tree on integer x in [0,100000]. To insert a line, compare it with the stored line at the interval midpoint, keep the larger there, and recursively insert the other only on the side where it can beat the stored line. A query takes the maximum along the root-to-leaf path. Use wide integer evaluations.
correctness: Two lines cross at most once, so after keeping the midpoint winner the other can improve the envelope on at most one side. Thus every line that could win at a query is represented on that query's path.
complexity: For q operations and coordinate domain size X=100001, O(q log X) time and O(q log X) worst-case dynamic-tree space, or O(X) with a fixed tree.
